# DeepPatient

> AI-Powered Clinical Skills Training Platform

DeepPatient provides safe, repeatable, and interactive AI patient encounters with instant rubric-based feedback for medical schools, nursing programs, and healthcare training institutions.

## Key Capabilities

- **Live AI Patient Simulation**: Interactive, unscripted conversational encounters with lifelike AI patients over live video. Patients dynamically respond to history-taking, questions, and clinical demeanor in real time.
- **Rubric-Based Objective Feedback**: Immediate post-session evaluation against institutional rubrics with plain-language diagnostic and communication breakdown. Exportable as comprehensive PDF reports.
- **Scenario Control & Customization**: Faculty and administrators can author custom patient cases, define clinical context, modulate patient behaviors/affect, and attach existing assessment frameworks without coding.
- **Faculty & Cohort Management**: Assign clinical cases to cohorts, track completion metrics, and identify systemic communication or diagnostic gaps across student groups.
- **Learner Dashboard**: Students track longitudinal skill development, review session transcripts, replay encounters, and monitor improvement over time.
- **Security & FERPA Alignment**: Role-based access control (RBAC), data encryption in transit and at rest, and FERPA-aligned data handling policies.

## User Personas & Permissions

- **Administrators**: Create and edit scenarios, define institutional rubrics, manage user permissions, and oversee platform configurations.
- **Faculty & Educators**: Assign scenarios to cohorts, view aggregate cohort performance, drill into individual student sessions, and review rubric scoring.
- **Learners (Medical & Nursing Students, Residents)**: Conduct live patient simulations, review instant feedback & transcripts, track personal progress over time.

## Evaluation & Assessment Framework

DeepPatient supports standard and custom clinical rubrics including:
- History-taking completeness and clinical reasoning
- Bedside manner, empathy, and active listening
- Diagnostic hypothesis formulation and follow-up planning
- OSCE (Objective Structured Clinical Examination) readiness

## Getting Started & Pilot Programs

- **Pilot Programs**: Structured pilots are available for qualifying medical schools, nursing colleges, and residency programs.
- **Onboarding Timeline**: Typical institutional rollout in 2 to 4 weeks, including custom rubric translation and scenario library preparation.
